===== M1084 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.GoogleCodingConvention.isConstant(String)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/GoogleCodingConvention.java
Original range: 70-87
Documentation:
/**
   * {@inheritDoc}
   *
   * <p>This enforces the Google const name convention, that the first character
   * after the last $ must be an upper-case letter and all subsequent letters
   * must be upper case. The name must be at least 2 characters long.
   *
   * <p>Examples:
   * <pre>
   *      aaa          Not constant - lower-case letters in the name
   *      A            Not constant - too short
   *      goog$A       Constant - letters after the $ are upper-case.
   *      AA17         Constant - digits can appear after the first letter
   *      goog$7A      Not constant - first character after the $ must be
   *                   upper case.
   *      $A           Constant - doesn't have to be anything in front of the $
   * </pre>
   */
Method code:
70 |   @Override
71 |   public boolean isConstant(String name) {
72 |     if (name.length() <= 1) {
73 |       return false;
74 |     }
75 | 
76 |     // In compiled code, '$' is often a namespace delimiter. To allow inlining
77 |     // of namespaced constants, we strip off any namespaces here.
78 |     int pos = name.lastIndexOf('$');
79 |     if (pos >= 0) {
80 |       name = name.substring(pos + 1);
81 |       if (name.length() == 0) {
82 |         return false;
83 |       }
84 |     }
85 | 
86 |     return isConstantKey(name);
87 |   }

===== M1100 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.rhino.jstype.FunctionType.isSubtype(JSType)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/rhino/jstype/FunctionType.java
Original range: 949-991
Documentation:
/**
   * A function is a subtype of another if their call methods are related via
   * subtyping and {@code this} is a subtype of {@code that} with regard to
   * the prototype chain.
   */
Method code:
949 |   @Override
950 |   public boolean isSubtype(JSType that) {
951 |     if (JSType.isSubtypeHelper(this, that)) {
952 |       return true;
953 |     }
954 | 
955 |     if (that.isFunctionType()) {
956 |       FunctionType other = that.toMaybeFunctionType();
957 |       if (other.isInterface()) {
958 |         // Any function can be assigned to an interface function.
959 |         return true;
960 |       }
961 |       if (this.isInterface()) {
962 |         // An interface function cannot be assigned to anything.
963 |         return false;
964 |       }
965 |       // If functionA is a subtype of functionB, then their "this" types
966 |       // should be contravariant. However, this causes problems because
967 |       // of the way we enforce overrides. Because function(this:SubFoo)
968 |       // is not a subtype of function(this:Foo), our override check treats
969 |       // this as an error. It also screws up out standard method
970 |       // for aliasing constructors. Let's punt on all this for now.
971 |       // TODO(nicksantos): fix this.
972 |       boolean treatThisTypesAsCovariant =
973 |         // If either one of these is a ctor, skip 'this' checking.
974 |         this.isConstructor() || other.isConstructor() ||
975 | 
976 |         // An interface 'this'-type is non-restrictive.
977 |         // In practical terms, if C implements I, and I has a method m,
978 |         // then any m doesn't necessarily have to C#m's 'this'
979 |         // type doesn't need to match I.
980 |         (other.typeOfThis.getConstructor() != null &&
981 |              other.typeOfThis.getConstructor().isInterface()) ||
982 | 
983 |         // If one of the 'this' types is covariant of the other,
984 |         // then we'll treat them as covariant (see comment above).
985 |         other.typeOfThis.isSubtype(this.typeOfThis) ||
986 |         this.typeOfThis.isSubtype(other.typeOfThis);
987 |       return treatThisTypesAsCovariant && this.call.isSubtype(other.call);
988 |     }
989 | 
990 |     return getNativeType(JSTypeNative.FUNCTION_PROTOTYPE).isSubtype(that);
991 |   }

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.TypedScopeCreator.AbstractScopeBuilder.createFunctionTypeFromNodes(Node,String,JSDocInfo,Node)

Documentation:
/**
     * Creates a new function type, based on the given nodes.
     *
     * This handles two cases that are semantically very different, but
     * are not mutually exclusive:
     * - A function literal that needs a type attached to it.
     * - An assignment expression with function-type info in the JsDoc.
     *
     * All parameters are optional, and we will do the best we can to create
     * a function type.
     *
     * This function will always create a function type, so only call it if
     * you're sure that's what you want.
     *
     * @param rValue The function node.
     * @param name the function's name
     * @param info the {@link JSDocInfo} attached to the function definition
     * @param lvalueNode The node where this function is being
     *     assigned. For example, {@code A.prototype.foo = ...} would be used to
     *     determine that this function is a method of A.prototype. May be
     *     null to indicate that this is not being assigned to a qualified name.
     */
Method code:
841 |     private FunctionType createFunctionTypeFromNodes(
842 |         @Nullable Node rValue,
843 |         @Nullable String name,
844 |         @Nullable JSDocInfo info,
845 |         @Nullable Node lvalueNode) {
846 | 
847 |       FunctionType functionType = null;
848 | 
849 |       // Global ctor aliases should be registered with the type registry.
850 |       if (rValue != null && rValue.isQualifiedName() && scope.isGlobal()) {
851 |         Var var = scope.getVar(rValue.getQualifiedName());
852 |         if (var != null && var.getType() != null &&
853 |             var.getType().isFunctionType()) {
854 |           FunctionType aliasedType  = var.getType().toMaybeFunctionType();
855 |           if ((aliasedType.isConstructor() || aliasedType.isInterface()) &&
856 |               !aliasedType.isNativeObjectType()) {
857 |             functionType = aliasedType;
858 | 
859 |             if (name != null && scope.isGlobal()) {
860 |               typeRegistry.declareType(name, functionType.getInstanceType());
861 |             }
862 |           }
863 |         }
864 |       }
865 | 
866 |       if (functionType == null) {
867 |         Node errorRoot = rValue == null ? lvalueNode : rValue;
868 |         boolean isFnLiteral =
869 |             rValue != null && rValue.isFunction();
870 |         Node fnRoot = isFnLiteral ? rValue : null;
871 |         Node parametersNode = isFnLiteral ?
872 |             rValue.getFirstChild().getNext() : null;
873 |         Node fnBlock = isFnLiteral ? parametersNode.getNext() : null;
874 | 
875 |         if (info != null && info.hasType()) {
876 |           JSType type = info.getType().evaluate(scope, typeRegistry);
877 | 
878 |           // Known to be not null since we have the FUNCTION token there.
879 |           type = type.restrictByNotNullOrUndefined();
880 |           if (type.isFunctionType()) {
881 |             functionType = type.toMaybeFunctionType();
882 |             functionType.setJSDocInfo(info);
883 |           }
884 |         }
885 | 
886 |         if (functionType == null) {
887 |           // Find the type of any overridden function.
888 |           Node ownerNode = NodeUtil.getBestLValueOwner(lvalueNode);
889 |           String ownerName = NodeUtil.getBestLValueName(ownerNode);
890 |           Var ownerVar = null;
891 |           String propName = null;
892 |           ObjectType ownerType = null;
893 |           if (ownerName != null) {
894 |             ownerVar = scope.getVar(ownerName);
895 |             if (ownerVar != null) {
896 |               ownerType = ObjectType.cast(ownerVar.getType());
897 |             }
898 |             if (name != null) {
899 |               propName = name.substring(ownerName.length() + 1);
900 |             }
901 |           }
902 | 
903 |           FunctionType overriddenPropType = null;
904 |           if (ownerType != null && propName != null) {
905 |             overriddenPropType =
906 |                 findOverriddenFunction(ownerType, propName);
907 |           }
908 | 
909 |           FunctionTypeBuilder builder =
910 |               new FunctionTypeBuilder(name, compiler, errorRoot, sourceName,
911 |                   scope)
912 |               .setContents(getFunctionAnalysisResults(fnRoot))
913 |               .inferFromOverriddenFunction(overriddenPropType, parametersNode)
914 |               .inferTemplateTypeName(info)
915 |               .inferReturnType(info)
916 |               .inferInheritance(info);
917 | 
918 | 
919 |           // Infer the context type.
920 |           boolean searchedForThisType = false;
921 |           if (ownerType != null && ownerType.isFunctionPrototypeType()) {
922 |             builder.inferThisType(
923 |                 info, ownerType.getOwnerFunction().getInstanceType());
924 |             searchedForThisType = true;
925 |           } else if (ownerNode != null && ownerNode.isThis()) {
926 |             // If 'this' has a type, use that instead.
927 |             // This is a hack, necessary because CollectProperties (below)
928 |             // doesn't run with the scope that it's building,
929 |             // so scope.getTypeOfThis() will be wrong.
930 |             JSType injectedThisType = ownerNode.getJSType();
931 |             builder.inferThisType(
932 |                 info,
933 |                 injectedThisType == null ?
934 |                 scope.getTypeOfThis() : injectedThisType);
935 |             searchedForThisType = true;
936 |           }
937 | 
938 |           if (!searchedForThisType) {
939 |             builder.inferThisType(info);
940 |           }
941 | 
942 |           functionType = builder
943 |               .inferParameterTypes(parametersNode, info)
944 |               .buildAndRegister();
945 |         }
946 |       }
947 | 
948 |       // all done
949 |       return functionType;
950 |     }

/**
   * Is a FUNCTION node an function expression? An function expression is one
   * that has either no name or a name that is not added to the current scope.
   *
   * <p>Some examples of function expressions:
   * <pre>
   * (function () {})
   * (function f() {})()
   * [ function f() {} ]
   * var f = function f() {};
   * for (function f() {};;) {}
   * </pre>
   *
   * <p>Some examples of functions that are <em>not</em> expressions:
   * <pre>
   * function f() {}
   * if (x); else function f() {}
   * for (;;) { function f() {} }
   * </pre>
   *
   * @param n A node
   * @return Whether n is an function used within an expression.
   */
Method code:
1910 |   static boolean isFunctionExpression(Node n) {
1911 |     return n.isFunction() && !isStatement(n);
1912 |   }

/**
   * Enforces type casts, and ensures the node is typed.
   *
   * A cast in the way that we use it in JSDoc annotations never
   * alters the generated code and therefore never can induce any runtime
   * operation. What this means is that a 'cast' is really just a compile
   * time constraint on the underlying value. In the future, we may add
   * support for run-time casts for compiled tests.
   *
   * To ensure some shred of sanity, we enforce the notion that the
   * type you are casting to may only meaningfully be a narrower type
   * than the underlying declared type. We also invalidate optimizations
   * on bad type casts.
   *
   * @param t The traversal object needed to report errors.
   * @param n The node getting a type assigned to it.
   * @param type The type to be assigned.
   */
Method code:
1883 |   private void ensureTyped(NodeTraversal t, Node n, JSType type) {
1884 |     // Make sure FUNCTION nodes always get function type.
1885 |     Preconditions.checkState(!n.isFunction() ||
1886 |             type.isFunctionType() ||
1887 |             type.isUnknownType());
1888 |     JSDocInfo info = n.getJSDocInfo();
1889 |     if (info != null) {
1890 |       if (info.hasType()) {
1891 |         JSType infoType = info.getType().evaluate(t.getScope(), typeRegistry);
1892 |         validator.expectCanCast(t, n, infoType, type);
1893 |         type = infoType;
1894 |       }
1895 | 
1896 |       if (info.isImplicitCast() && !inExterns) {
1897 |         String propName = n.isGetProp() ?
1898 |             n.getLastChild().getString() : "(missing)";
1899 |         compiler.report(
1900 |             t.makeError(n, ILLEGAL_IMPLICIT_CAST, propName));
1901 |       }
1902 |     }
1903 | 
1904 |     if (n.getJSType() == null) {
1905 |       n.setJSType(type);
1906 |     }
1907 |   }

258 |   @Override
259 |   public boolean equals(Object other) {
260 |     if (other instanceof LinkedFlowScope) {
261 |       LinkedFlowScope that = (LinkedFlowScope) other;
262 |       if (this.optimize() == that.optimize()) {
263 |         return true;
264 |       }
265 | 
266 |       // If two flow scopes are in the same function, then they could have
267 |       // two possible function scopes: the real one and the BOTTOM scope.
268 |       // If they have different function scopes, we *should* iterate through all
269 |       // the variables in each scope and compare. However, 99.9% of the time,
270 |       // they're not equal. And the other .1% of the time, we can pretend
271 |       // they're equal--this just means that data flow analysis will have
272 |       // to propagate the entry lattice a little bit further than it
273 |       // really needs to. Everything will still come out ok.
274 |       if (this.getFunctionScope() != that.getFunctionScope()) {
275 |         return false;
276 |       }
277 | 
278 |       if (cache == that.cache) {
279 |         // If the two flow scopes have the same cache, then we can check
280 |         // equality a lot faster: by just looking at the "dirty" elements
281 |         // in the cache, and comparing them in both scopes.
282 |         for (String name : cache.dirtySymbols) {
283 |           if (diffSlots(getSlot(name), that.getSlot(name))) {
284 |             return false;
285 |           }
286 |         }
287 | 
288 |         return true;
289 |       }
290 | 
291 |       Map<String, StaticSlot<JSType>> myFlowSlots = allFlowSlots();
292 |       Map<String, StaticSlot<JSType>> otherFlowSlots = that.allFlowSlots();
293 | 
294 |       for (StaticSlot<JSType> slot : myFlowSlots.values()) {
295 |         if (diffSlots(slot, otherFlowSlots.get(slot.getName()))) {
296 |           return false;
297 |         }
298 |         otherFlowSlots.remove(slot.getName());
299 |       }
300 |       for (StaticSlot<JSType> slot : otherFlowSlots.values()) {
301 |         if (diffSlots(slot, myFlowSlots.get(slot.getName()))) {
302 |           return false;
303 |         }
304 |       }
305 |       return true;
306 |     }
307 |     return false;
308 |   }

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.NodeTraversal.traverseFunction(Node,Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeTraversal.java
Original range: 510-545
Documentation:
/**
   * Traverses a function.
   */
Method code:
510 |   private void traverseFunction(Node n, Node parent) {
511 |     Preconditions.checkState(n.getChildCount() == 3);
512 |     Preconditions.checkState(n.isFunction());
513 | 
514 |     final Node fnName = n.getFirstChild();
515 | 
516 |     boolean isFunctionExpression = (parent != null)
517 |         && NodeUtil.isFunctionExpression(n);
518 | 
519 |     if (!isFunctionExpression) {
520 |       // Functions declarations are in the scope containing the declaration.
521 |       traverseBranch(fnName, n);
522 |     }
523 | 
524 |     curNode = n;
525 |     pushScope(n);
526 | 
527 |     if (isFunctionExpression) {
528 |       // Function expression names are only accessible within the function
529 |       // scope.
530 |       traverseBranch(fnName, n);
531 |     }
532 | 
533 |     final Node args = fnName.getNext();
534 |     final Node body = args.getNext();
535 | 
536 |     // Args
537 |     traverseBranch(args, n);
538 | 
539 |     // Body
540 |     Preconditions.checkState(body.getNext() == null &&
541 |             body.isBlock(), body);
542 |     traverseBranch(body, n);
543 | 
544 |     popScope();
545 |   }

/**
   * Visits a {@link Token#FUNCTION} node.
   *
   * @param t The node traversal object that supplies context, such as the
   * scope chain to use in name lookups as well as error reporting.
   * @param n The node being visited.

Method code:
1523 |   private void visitFunction(NodeTraversal t, Node n) {
1524 |     FunctionType functionType = JSType.toMaybeFunctionType(n.getJSType());
1525 |     String functionPrivateName = n.getFirstChild().getString();
1526 |     if (functionType.isConstructor()) {
1527 |       FunctionType baseConstructor = functionType.getSuperClassConstructor();
1528 |       if (baseConstructor != null &&
1529 |           baseConstructor != getNativeType(OBJECT_FUNCTION_TYPE) &&
1530 |           (baseConstructor.isInterface() && functionType.isConstructor())) {
1531 |         compiler.report(
1532 |             t.makeError(n, CONFLICTING_EXTENDED_TYPE, functionPrivateName));
1533 |       } else {
1534 |         // All interfaces are properly implemented by a class
1535 |         for (JSType baseInterface : functionType.getImplementedInterfaces()) {
1536 |           boolean badImplementedType = false;
1537 |           ObjectType baseInterfaceObj = ObjectType.cast(baseInterface);
1538 |           if (baseInterfaceObj != null) {
1539 |             FunctionType interfaceConstructor =
1540 |               baseInterfaceObj.getConstructor();
1541 |             if (interfaceConstructor != null &&
1542 |                 !interfaceConstructor.isInterface()) {
1543 |               badImplementedType = true;
1544 |             }
1545 |           } else {
1546 |             badImplementedType = true;
1547 |           }
1548 |           if (badImplementedType) {
1549 |             report(t, n, BAD_IMPLEMENTED_TYPE, functionPrivateName);
1550 |           }
1551 |         }
1552 |         // check properties
1553 |         validator.expectAllInterfaceProperties(t, n, functionType);
1554 |       }
1555 |     } else if (functionType.isInterface()) {
1556 |       // Interface must extend only interfaces
1557 |       for (ObjectType extInterface : functionType.getExtendedInterfaces()) {
1558 |         if (extInterface.getConstructor() != null
1559 |             && !extInterface.getConstructor().isInterface()) {
1560 |           compiler.report(
1561 |               t.makeError(n, CONFLICTING_EXTENDED_TYPE, functionPrivateName));
1562 |         }
1563 |       }
1564 |       // Interface cannot implement any interfaces
1565 |       if (functionType.hasImplementedInterfaces()) {
1566 |         compiler.report(t.makeError(n,
1567 |             CONFLICTING_IMPLEMENTED_TYPE, functionPrivateName));
1568 |       }
1569 |       // Check whether the extended interfaces have any conflicts
1570 |       if (functionType.getExtendedInterfacesCount() > 1) {
1571 |         // Only check when extending more than one interfaces
1572 |         HashMap<String, ObjectType> properties
1573 |             = new HashMap<String, ObjectType>();

/**
   * @param compareJsType Whether to compare the JSTypes of the nodes.

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.TypeCheck.checkPropertyAccess(JSType,String,NodeTraversal,Node)

Original range: 1334-1361
Documentation:
/**
   * Emit a warning if we can prove that a property cannot possibly be
   * defined on an object. Note the difference between JS and a strictly
   * statically typed language: we're checking if the property
   * *cannot be defined*, whereas a java compiler would check if the
   * property *can be undefined*.
   */
Method code:
1334 |   private void checkPropertyAccess(JSType childType, String propName,
1335 |       NodeTraversal t, Node n) {
1336 |     // If the property type is unknown, check the object type to see if it
1337 |     // can ever be defined. We explicitly exclude CHECKED_UNKNOWN (for
1338 |     // properties where we've checked that it exists, or for properties on
1339 |     // objects that aren't in this binary).
1340 |     JSType propType = getJSType(n);
1341 |     if (propType.equals(typeRegistry.getNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE))) {
1342 |       childType = childType.autobox();
1343 |       ObjectType objectType = ObjectType.cast(childType);
1344 |       if (objectType != null) {
1345 |         // We special-case object types so that checks on enums can be
1346 |         // much stricter, and so that we can use hasProperty (which is much
1347 |         // faster in most cases).
1348 |         if (!objectType.hasProperty(propName) ||
1349 |             objectType.equals(typeRegistry.getNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE))) {
1350 |           if (objectType instanceof EnumType) {
1351 |             report(t, n, INEXISTENT_ENUM_ELEMENT, propName);
1352 |           } else {
1353 |             checkPropertyAccessHelper(objectType, propName, t, n);
1354 |           }
1355 |         }
1356 |

307 |     public void collect(NodeTraversal t, Node n, Node parent) {
308 |       if (nodeFilter != null && !nodeFilter.apply(n)) {

313 |       // generated by them, so that we can do lookups in it later.

315 |         externsScope = t.getScope();
316 |       }
317 | 
318 |       String name;
319 |       boolean isSet = false;
320 |       Name.Type type = Name.Type.OTHER;
321 |       boolean isPropAssign = false;
322 | 
323 |       switch (n.getType()) {
324 |         case Token.GETTER_DEF:
325 |         case Token.SETTER_DEF:

328 |           name = null;

337 |               break;
338 |             case Token.GETTER_DEF:

340 |               break;
341 |             case Token.SETTER_DEF:
342 |               type = Name.Type.SET;
343 |               break;
344 |             default:
345 |               throw new IllegalStateException("unexpected:" + n);
346 |           }
347 |           break;
348 |         case Token.NAME:
349 |           // This may be a variable get or set.
350 |           if (parent != null) {
351 |             switch (parent.getType()) {
352 |               case Token.VAR:
353 |                 isSet = true;
354 |                 Node rvalue = n.getFirstChild();
355 |                 type = rvalue == null ? Name.Type.OTHER : getValueType(rvalue);
356 |                 break;
357 |               case Token.ASSIGN:
358 |                 if (parent.getFirstChild() == n) {
359 |                   isSet = true;
360 |                   type = getValueType(n.getNext());
361 |                 }
362 |                 break;
363 |               case Token.GETPROP:
364 |                 return;
365 |               case Token.FUNCTION:
366 |                 Node gramps = parent.getParent();
367 |                 if (gramps == null ||
368 |                     NodeUtil.isFunctionExpression(parent)) return;
369 |                 isSet = true;
370 |                 type = Name.Type.FUNCTION;
371 |                 break;
372 |               case Token.INC:
373 |               case Token.DEC:
374 |                 isSet = true;
375 |                 type = Name.Type.OTHER;
376 |                 break;
377 |               default:
378 |                 if (NodeUtil.isAssignmentOp(parent) &&
379 |                     parent.getFirstChild() == n) {
380 |                   isSet = true;
381 |                   type = Name.Type.OTHER;
382 |                 }
383 |             }
384 |           }
385 |           name = n.getString();
386 |           break;
387 |         case Token.GETPROP:
388 |           // This may be a namespaced name get or set.
389 |           if (parent != null) {
390 |             switch (parent.getType()) {
391 |               case Token.ASSIGN:
392 |                 if (parent.getFirstChild() == n) {
393 |                   isSet = true;
394 |                   type = getValueType(n.getNext());
395 |                   isPropAssign = true;
396 |                 }
397 |                 break;
398 |               case Token.INC:
399 |               case Token.DEC:
400 |                 isSet = true;
401 |                 type = Name.Type.OTHER;
402 |                 break;
403 |               case Token.GETPROP:
404 |                 return;
405 |               default:
406 |                 if (NodeUtil.isAssignmentOp(parent) &&
407 |                     parent.getFirstChild() == n) {
408 |                   isSet = true;
409 |                   type = Name.Type.OTHER;
410 |                 }
411 |             }
412 |           }
413 |           name = n.getQualifiedName();
414 |           if (name == null) return;
415 |           break;
416 |         default:
417 |           return;
418 |       }
419 | 
420 |       // We are only interested in global names.
421 |       Scope scope = t.getScope();
422 |       if (!isGlobalNameReference(name, scope)) {
423 |         return;
424 |       }
425 | 
426 |       if (isSet) {

429 |         } else {

431 |         }
432 |       } else {

434 |       }
435 |     }

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.CodeGenerator.add(Node,Context)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/CodeGenerator.java
Original range: 85-732

85 |   void add(Node n, Context context) {
86 |     if (!cc.continueProcessing()) {
87 |       return;
88 |     }
89 | 
90 |     int type = n.getType();
91 |     String opstr = NodeUtil.opToStr(type);
92 |     int childCount = n.getChildCount();
93 |     Node first = n.getFirstChild();
94 |     Node last = n.getLastChild();
95 | 
96 |     // Handle all binary operators
97 |     if (opstr != null && first != last) {
98 |       Preconditions.checkState(
99 |           childCount == 2,
100 |           "Bad binary operator \"%s\": expected 2 arguments but got %s",
101 |           opstr, childCount);
102 |       int p = NodeUtil.precedence(type);
103 | 
104 |       // For right-hand-side of operations, only pass context if it's
105 |       // the IN_FOR_INIT_CLAUSE one.
106 |       Context rhsContext = getContextForNoInOperator(context);
107 | 
108 |       // Handle associativity.
109 |       // e.g. if the parse tree is a * (b * c),
110 |       // we can simply generate a * b * c.
111 |       if (last.getType() == type &&
112 |           NodeUtil.isAssociative(type)) {
113 |         addExpr(first, p, context);
114 |         cc.addOp(opstr, true);
115 |         addExpr(last, p, rhsContext);
116 |       } else if (NodeUtil.isAssignmentOp(n) && NodeUtil.isAssignmentOp(last)) {
117 |         // Assignments are the only right-associative binary operators
118 |         addExpr(first, p, context);
119 |         cc.addOp(opstr, true);
120 |         addExpr(last, p, rhsContext);
121 |       } else {
122 |         unrollBinaryOperator(n, type, opstr, context, rhsContext, p, p + 1);
123 |       }
124 |       return;
125 |     }
126 | 
127 |     cc.startSourceMapping(n);
128 | 
129 |     switch (type) {
130 |       case Token.TRY: {
131 |         Preconditions.checkState(first.getNext().isBlock() &&
132 |                 !first.getNext().hasMoreThanOneChild());
133 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount >= 2 && childCount <= 3);
134 | 
135 |         add("try");
136 |         add(first, Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK);
137 | 
138 |         // second child contains the catch block, or nothing if there
139 |         // isn't a catch block
140 |         Node catchblock = first.getNext().getFirstChild();
141 |         if (catchblock != null) {
142 |           add(catchblock);
143 |         }
144 | 
145 |         if (childCount == 3) {
146 |           add("finally");
147 |           add(last, Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK);
148 |         }
149 |         break;
150 |       }
151 | 
152 |       case Token.CATCH:
153 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
154 |         add("catch(");
155 |         add(first);
156 |         add(")");
157 |         add(last, Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK);
158 |         break;
159 | 
160 |       case Token.THROW:
161 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
162 |         add("throw");
163 |         add(first);
164 | 
165 |         // Must have a ';' after a throw statement, otherwise safari can't
166 |         // parse this.
167 |         cc.endStatement(true);
168 |         break;
169 | 
170 |       case Token.RETURN:
171 |         add("return");
172 |         if (childCount == 1) {
173 |           add(first);
174 |         } else {
175 |           Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
176 |         }
177 |         cc.endStatement();
178 |         break;

184 |         }

189 |         addIdentifier(n.getString());
190 |         break;
191 | 
192 |       case Token.NAME:
193 |         if (first == null || first.isEmpty()) {
194 |           addIdentifier(n.getString());
195 |         } else {
196 |           Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
197 |           addIdentifier(n.getString());
198 |           cc.addOp("=", true);
199 |           if (first.isComma()) {
200 |             addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(Token.ASSIGN), Context.OTHER);
201 |           } else {
202 |             // Add expression, consider nearby code at lowest level of
203 |             // precedence.
204 |             addExpr(first, 0, getContextForNoInOperator(context));
205 |           }
206 |         }
207 |         break;
208 | 
209 |       case Token.ARRAYLIT:
210 |         add("[");
211 |         addArrayList(first);
212 |         add("]");
213 |         break;
214 | 
215 |       case Token.PARAM_LIST:
216 |         add("(");
217 |         addList(first);
218 |         add(")");
219 |         break;
220 | 
221 |       case Token.COMMA:
222 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
223 |         unrollBinaryOperator(n, Token.COMMA, ",", context, Context.OTHER, 0, 0);
224 |         break;
225 | 
226 |       case Token.NUMBER:
227 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
228 |         cc.addNumber(n.getDouble());
229 |         break;
230 | 
231 |       case Token.TYPEOF:
232 |       case Token.VOID:
233 |       case Token.NOT:
234 |       case Token.BITNOT:
235 |       case Token.POS: {
236 |         // All of these unary operators are right-associative
237 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
238 |         cc.addOp(NodeUtil.opToStrNoFail(type), false);
239 |         addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), Context.OTHER);
240 |         break;
241 |       }
242 | 
243 |       case Token.NEG: {
244 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
245 | 
246 |         // It's important to our sanity checker that the code
247 |         // we print produces the same AST as the code we parse back.
248 |         // NEG is a weird case because Rhino parses "- -2" as "2".
249 |         if (n.getFirstChild().isNumber()) {
250 |           cc.addNumber(-n.getFirstChild().getDouble());
251 |         } else {

253 |           addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), Context.OTHER);
254 |         }
255 |

257 |       }

260 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 3);
261 |         int p = NodeUtil.precedence(type);
262 |         addExpr(first, p + 1, context);

266 |         addExpr(last, 1, Context.OTHER);
267 |         break;

274 |         }

277 | 
278 |         // I only use one .add because whitespace matters
279 |         if (childCount == 2) {
280 |           add(regexp + last.getString());
281 |         } else {
282 |           Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
283 |           add(regexp);
284 |         }
285 |         break;
286 | 
287 |       case Token.FUNCTION:
288 |         if (n.getClass() != Node.class) {
289 |           throw new Error("Unexpected Node subclass.");
290 |         }
291 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 3);
292 |         boolean funcNeedsParens = (context == Context.START_OF_EXPR);
293 |         if (funcNeedsParens) {
294 |           add("(");
295 |         }
296 | 
297 |         add("function");
298 |         add(first);
299 | 
300 |         add(first.getNext());
301 |         add(last, Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK);
302 |         cc.endFunction(context == Context.STATEMENT);
303 | 
304 |         if (funcNeedsParens) {
305 |           add(")");
306 |         }
307 |         break;
308 | 
309 |       case Token.GETTER_DEF:
310 |       case Token.SETTER_DEF:
311 |         Preconditions.checkState(n.getParent().isObjectLit());
312 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
313 |         Preconditions.checkState(first.isFunction());
314 | 
315 |         // Get methods are unnamed
316 |         Preconditions.checkState(first.getFirstChild().getString().isEmpty());
317 |         if (type == Token.GETTER_DEF) {
318 |           // Get methods have no parameters.
319 |           Preconditions.checkState(!first.getChildAtIndex(1).hasChildren());
320 |           add("get ");
321 |         } else {
322 |           // Set methods have one parameter.
323 |           Preconditions.checkState(first.getChildAtIndex(1).hasOneChild());
324 |           add("set ");
325 |         }
326 | 
327 |         // The name is on the GET or SET node.
328 |         String name = n.getString();
329 |         Node fn = first;
330 |         Node parameters = fn.getChildAtIndex(1);
331 |         Node body = fn.getLastChild();
332 | 
333 |         // Add the property name.
334 |         if (!n.isQuotedString() &&
335 |             TokenStream.isJSIdentifier(name) &&
336 |             // do not encode literally any non-literal characters that were
337 |             // Unicode escaped.
338 |             NodeUtil.isLatin(name)) {
339 |           add(name);
340 |         } else {
341 |           // Determine if the string is a simple number.
342 |           double d = getSimpleNumber(name);
343 |           if (!Double.isNaN(d)) {
344 |             cc.addNumber(d);
345 |           } else {
346 |             addJsString(n);
347 |           }
348 |         }
349 | 
350 |         add(parameters);
351 |         add(body, Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK);
352 |         break;
353 | 
354 |       case Token.SCRIPT:
355 |       case Token.BLOCK: {
356 |         if (n.getClass() != Node.class) {
357 |           throw new Error("Unexpected Node subclass.");
358 |         }
359 |         boolean preserveBlock = context == Context.PRESERVE_BLOCK;
360 |         if (preserveBlock) {
361 |           cc.beginBlock();
362 |         }
363 | 
364 |         boolean preferLineBreaks =
365 |             type == Token.SCRIPT ||
366 |             (type == Token.BLOCK &&
367 |                 !preserveBlock &&
368 |                 n.getParent() != null &&
369 |                 n.getParent().isScript());
370 |         for (Node c = first; c != null; c = c.getNext()) {
371 |           add(c, Context.STATEMENT);
372 | 
373 |           // VAR doesn't include ';' since it gets used in expressions
374 |           if (c.isVar()) {
375 |             cc.endStatement();
376 |           }
377 | 
378 |           if (c.isFunction()) {
379 |             cc.maybeLineBreak();
380 |           }
381 | 
382 |           // Prefer to break lines in between top-level statements
383 |           // because top-level statements are more homogeneous.
384 |           if (preferLineBreaks) {
385 |             cc.notePreferredLineBreak();
386 |           }
387 |         }
388 |         if (preserveBlock) {
389 |           cc.endBlock(cc.breakAfterBlockFor(n, context == Context.STATEMENT));
390 |         }
391 |         break;
392 |       }
393 | 
394 |       case Token.FOR:
395 |         if (childCount == 4) {
396 |           add("for(");
397 |           if (first.isVar()) {
398 |             add(first, Context.IN_FOR_INIT_CLAUSE);
399 |           } else {
400 |             addExpr(first, 0, Context.IN_FOR_INIT_CLAUSE);
401 |           }
402 |           add(";");
403 |           add(first.getNext());
404 |           add(";");
405 |           add(first.getNext().getNext());
406 |           add(")");
407 |           addNonEmptyStatement(
408 |               last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), false);
409 |         } else {
410 |           Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 3);
411 |           add("for(");
412 |           add(first);
413 |           add("in");
414 |           add(first.getNext());
415 |           add(")");
416 |           addNonEmptyStatement(
417 |               last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), false);
418 |         }
419 |         break;
420 | 
421 |       case Token.DO:
422 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
423 |         add("do");
424 |         addNonEmptyStatement(first, Context.OTHER, false);
425 |         add("while(");
426 |         add(last);
427 |         add(")");
428 |         cc.endStatement();
429 |         break;
430 | 
431 |       case Token.WHILE:
432 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
433 |         add("while(");
434 |         add(first);
435 |         add(")");
436 |         addNonEmptyStatement(
437 |             last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), false);
438 |         break;
439 | 
440 |       case Token.EMPTY:
441 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
442 |         break;
443 | 
444 |       case Token.GETPROP: {
445 |         Preconditions.checkState(
446 |             childCount == 2,
447 |             "Bad GETPROP: expected 2 children, but got %s", childCount);
448 |         Preconditions.checkState(
449 |             last.isString(),
450 |             "Bad GETPROP: RHS should be STRING");
451 |         boolean needsParens = (first.isNumber());
452 |         if (needsParens) {
453 |           add("(");
454 |         }
455 |         addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), context);
456 |         if (needsParens) {
457 |           add(")");
458 |         }
459 |         add(".");
460 |         addIdentifier(last.getString());
461 |         break;
462 |       }
463 | 
464 |       case Token.GETELEM:
465 |         Preconditions.checkState(
466 |             childCount == 2,
467 |             "Bad GETELEM: expected 2 children but got %s", childCount);
468 |         addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), context);
469 |         add("[");
470 |         add(first.getNext());
471 |         add("]");
472 |         break;
473 | 
474 |       case Token.WITH:
475 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
476 |         add("with(");
477 |         add(first);
478 |         add(")");
479 |         addNonEmptyStatement(
480 |             last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), false);
481 |         break;
482 | 
483 |       case Token.INC:
484 |       case Token.DEC: {
485 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
486 |         String o = type == Token.INC ? "++" : "--";
487 |         int postProp = n.getIntProp(Node.INCRDECR_PROP);
488 |         // A non-zero post-prop value indicates a post inc/dec, default of zero
489 |         // is a pre-inc/dec.
490 |         if (postProp != 0) {
491 |           addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), context);
492 |           cc.addOp(o, false);
493 |         } else {
494 |           cc.addOp(o, false);
495 |           add(first);
496 |         }
497 |         break;
498 |       }
499 | 
500 |       case Token.CALL:
501 |         // We have two special cases here:
502 |         // 1) If the left hand side of the call is a direct reference to eval,
503 |         // then it must have a DIRECT_EVAL annotation. If it does not, then
504 |         // that means it was originally an indirect call to eval, and that
505 |         // indirectness must be preserved.
506 |         // 2) If the left hand side of the call is a property reference,
507 |         // then the call must not a FREE_CALL annotation. If it does, then
508 |         // that means it was originally an call without an explicit this and
509 |         // that must be preserved.
510 |         if (isIndirectEval(first)
511 |             || n.getBooleanProp(Node.FREE_CALL) && NodeUtil.isGet(first)) {
512 |           add("(0,");
513 |           addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(Token.COMMA), Context.OTHER);
514 |           add(")");
515 |         } else {
516 |           addExpr(first, NodeUtil.precedence(type), context);
517 |         }
518 |         add("(");
519 |         addList(first.getNext());
520 |         add(")");
521 |         break;
522 | 
523 |       case Token.IF:
524 |         boolean hasElse = childCount == 3;
525 |         boolean ambiguousElseClause =
526 |             context == Context.BEFORE_DANGLING_ELSE && !hasElse;
527 |         if (ambiguousElseClause) {
528 |           cc.beginBlock();
529 |         }
530 | 
531 |         add("if(");
532 |         add(first);
533 |         add(")");
534 | 
535 |         if (hasElse) {
536 |           addNonEmptyStatement(
537 |               first.getNext(), Context.BEFORE_DANGLING_ELSE, false);
538 |           add("else");
539 |           addNonEmptyStatement(
540 |               last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), false);
541 |         } else {
542 |           addNonEmptyStatement(first.getNext(), Context.OTHER, false);
543 |           Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
544 |         }
545 | 
546 |         if (ambiguousElseClause) {
547 |           cc.endBlock();
548 |         }
549 |         break;
550 | 
551 |       case Token.NULL:
552 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
553 |         cc.addConstant("null");
554 |         break;
555 | 
556 |       case Token.THIS:
557 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
558 |         add("this");
559 |         break;
560 | 
561 |       case Token.FALSE:
562 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
563 |         cc.addConstant("false");
564 |         break;
565 | 
566 |       case Token.TRUE:
567 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
568 |         cc.addConstant("true");
569 |         break;
570 | 
571 |       case Token.CONTINUE:
572 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount <= 1);
573 |         add("continue");
574 |         if (childCount == 1) {
575 |           if (!first.isLabelName()) {
576 |             throw new Error("Unexpected token type. Should be LABEL_NAME.");
577 |           }
578 |           add(" ");
579 |           add(first);
580 |         }
581 |         cc.endStatement();
582 |         break;
583 | 
584 |       case Token.DEBUGGER:
585 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 0);
586 |         add("debugger");
587 |         cc.endStatement();
588 |         break;
589 | 
590 |       case Token.BREAK:
591 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount <= 1);
592 |         add("break");
593 |         if (childCount == 1) {
594 |           if (!first.isLabelName()) {
595 |             throw new Error("Unexpected token type. Should be LABEL_NAME.");
596 |           }
597 |           add(" ");
598 |           add(first);
599 |         }
600 |         cc.endStatement();
601 |         break;
602 | 
603 |       case Token.EXPR_RESULT:
604 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
605 |         add(first, Context.START_OF_EXPR);
606 |         cc.endStatement();
607 |         break;
608 | 
609 |       case Token.NEW:
610 |         add("new ");
611 |         int precedence = NodeUtil.precedence(type);
612 | 
613 |         // If the first child contains a CALL, then claim higher precedence
614 |         // to force parentheses. Otherwise, when parsed, NEW will bind to the
615 |         // first viable parentheses (don't traverse into functions).
616 |         if (NodeUtil.containsType(
617 |             first, Token.CALL, NodeUtil.MATCH_NOT_FUNCTION)) {
618 |           precedence = NodeUtil.precedence(first.getType()) + 1;
619 |         }
620 |         addExpr(first, precedence, Context.OTHER);
621 | 
622 |         // '()' is optional when no arguments are present
623 |         Node next = first.getNext();
624 |         if (next != null) {
625 |           add("(");
626 |           addList(next);
627 |           add(")");
628 |         }
629 |         break;
630 | 
631 |       case Token.STRING_KEY:
632 |         Preconditions.checkState(
633 |             childCount == 1, "Object lit key must have 1 child");
634 |         addJsString(n);
635 |         break;
636 | 
637 |       case Token.STRING:
638 |         Preconditions.checkState(
639 |             childCount == 0, "A string may not have children");
640 |         addJsString(n);
641 |         break;
642 | 
643 |       case Token.DELPROP:
644 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
645 |         add("delete ");
646 |         add(first);
647 |         break;
648 | 
649 |       case Token.OBJECTLIT: {
650 |         boolean needsParens = (context == Context.START_OF_EXPR);
651 |         if (needsParens) {
652 |           add("(");
653 |         }
654 |         add("{");
655 |         for (Node c = first; c != null; c = c.getNext()) {
656 |           if (c != first) {
657 |             cc.listSeparator();
658 |           }
659 | 
660 |           if (c.isGetterDef() || c.isSetterDef()) {
661 |             add(c);
662 |           } else {
663 |             Preconditions.checkState(c.isStringKey());
664 |             String key = c.getString();
665 |             // Object literal property names don't have to be quoted if they
666 |             // are not JavaScript keywords
667 |             if (!c.isQuotedString() &&
668 |                 !TokenStream.isKeyword(key) &&
669 |                 TokenStream.isJSIdentifier(key) &&
670 |                 // do not encode literally any non-literal characters that
671 |                 // were Unicode escaped.
672 |                 NodeUtil.isLatin(key)) {
673 |               add(key);
674 |             } else {
675 |               // Determine if the string is a simple number.
676 |               double d = getSimpleNumber(key);
677 |               if (!Double.isNaN(d)) {
678 |                 cc.addNumber(d);
679 |               } else {
680 |                 addExpr(c, 1, Context.OTHER);
681 |               }
682 |             }
683 |             add(":");
684 |             addExpr(c.getFirstChild(), 1, Context.OTHER);
685 |           }
686 |         }
687 |         add("}");
688 |         if (needsParens) {
689 |           add(")");
690 |         }
691 |         break;
692 |       }
693 | 
694 |       case Token.SWITCH:
695 |         add("switch(");
696 |         add(first);
697 |         add(")");
698 |         cc.beginBlock();
699 |         addAllSiblings(first.getNext());
700 |         cc.endBlock(context == Context.STATEMENT);
701 |         break;
702 | 
703 |       case Token.CASE:
704 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
705 |         add("case ");
706 |         add(first);
707 |         addCaseBody(last);
708 |         break;
709 | 
710 |       case Token.DEFAULT_CASE:
711 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 1);
712 |         add("default");
713 |         addCaseBody(first);
714 |         break;
715 | 
716 |       case Token.LABEL:
717 |         Preconditions.checkState(childCount == 2);
718 |         if (!first.isLabelName()) {
719 |           throw new Error("Unexpected token type. Should be LABEL_NAME.");
720 |         }
721 |         add(first);
722 |         add(":");
723 |         addNonEmptyStatement(
724 |             last, getContextForNonEmptyExpression(context), true);
725 |         break;
726 | 
727 |       default:
728 |         throw new Error("Unknown type " + type + "\n" + n.toStringTree());
729 |     }
730 | 
731 |     cc.endSourceMapping(n);
732 |   }

288 |   public void traverseRoots(List<Node> roots) {
289 |     if (roots.isEmpty()) {
290 |       return;
291 |     }
292 |

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.TypeInference.getPropertyType(JSType,String,Node,FlowScope)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeInference.java
Original range: 1197-1248
Documentation:

Method code:
1197 |   private JSType getPropertyType(JSType objType, String propName,
1198 |       Node n, FlowScope scope) {
1199 |     // We often have a couple of different types to choose from for the
1200 |     // property. Ordered by accuracy, we have
1201 |     // 1) A locally inferred qualified name (which is in the FlowScope)
1202 |     // 2) A globally declared qualified name (which is in the FlowScope)
1203 |     // 3) A property on the owner type (which is on objType)
1204 |     // 4) A name in the type registry (as a last resort)
1205 |     JSType unknownType = getNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE);
1206 |     JSType propertyType = null;
1207 |     boolean isLocallyInferred = false;
1208 | 
1209 |     // Scopes sometimes contain inferred type info about qualified names.
1210 |     String qualifiedName = n.getQualifiedName();
1211 |     StaticSlot<JSType> var = scope.getSlot(qualifiedName);
1212 |     if (var != null) {
1213 |       JSType varType = var.getType();
1214 |       if (varType != null) {
1215 |         boolean isDeclared = !var.isTypeInferred();
1216 |         isLocallyInferred = (var != syntacticScope.getSlot(qualifiedName));
1217 |         if (isDeclared || isLocallyInferred) {
1218 |           propertyType = varType;
1219 |         }
1220 |       }
1221 |     }
1222 | 
1223 |     if (propertyType == null && objType != null) {
1224 |       JSType foundType = objType.findPropertyType(propName);
1225 |       if (foundType != null) {
1226 |         propertyType = foundType;
1227 |       }
1228 |     }
1229 | 
1230 |     if ((propertyType == null || propertyType.isUnknownType())
1231 |         && qualifiedName != null) {
1232 |       // If we find this node in the registry, then we can infer its type.
1233 |       ObjectType regType = ObjectType.cast(registry.getType(qualifiedName));
1234 |       if (regType != null) {
1235 |         propertyType = regType.getConstructor();
1236 |       }
1237 |     }
1238 | 
1239 |     if (propertyType == null) {
1240 |       return getNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE);
1241 |     } else if (propertyType.equals(unknownType) && isLocallyInferred) {
1242 |       // If the type has been checked in this scope,
1243 |       // then use CHECKED_UNKNOWN_TYPE instead to indicate that.
1244 |       return getNativeType(CHECKED_UNKNOWN_TYPE);
1245 |     } else {
1246 |       return propertyType;
1247 |     }
1248 |   }

/**
   * Connects cfgNode to the proper CATCH block if target subtree might throw
   * an exception. If there are FINALLY blocks reached before a CATCH, it will
   * make the corresponding entry in finallyMap.
   */
Method code:
830 |   private void connectToPossibleExceptionHandler(Node cfgNode, Node target) {
831 |     if (mayThrowException(target) && !exceptionHandler.isEmpty()) {
832 |       Node lastJump = cfgNode;
833 |       for (Node handler : exceptionHandler) {
834 |         if (handler.isFunction()) {
835 |           return;

841 |           if (lastJump == cfgNode) {

843 |           } else {

848 |             createEdge(cfgNode, Branch.ON_EX, catchBlock);
849 |             return;
850 |           } else {
851 |             finallyMap.put(lastJump, catchBlock);
852 |           }

855 |       }

/**
   * Look ahead for a type annotation by advancing the character stream.
   * Does not modify the token stream.
   * This is kind of a hack, and is only necessary because we use the token
   * stream to parse types, but need the underlying character stream to get
   * JsDoc descriptions.

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.FunctionTypeBuilder.inferFromOverriddenFunction(FunctionType,Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/FunctionTypeBuilder.java
Original range: 243-301
Documentation:
/**
   * Infer the parameter and return types of a function from
   * the parameter and return types of the function it is overriding.
   *
   * @param oldType The function being overridden. Does nothing if this is null.
   * @param paramsParent The LP node of the function that we're assigning to.
   *     If null, that just means we're not initializing this to a function
   *     literal.
   */
Method code:
243 |   FunctionTypeBuilder inferFromOverriddenFunction(
244 |       @Nullable FunctionType oldType, @Nullable Node paramsParent) {
245 |     if (oldType == null) {
246 |       return this;
247 |     }
248 | 
249 |     returnType = oldType.getReturnType();
250 |     returnTypeInferred = oldType.isReturnTypeInferred();
251 |     if (paramsParent == null) {
252 |       // Not a function literal.
253 |       parametersNode = oldType.getParametersNode();
254 |       if (parametersNode == null) {
255 |         parametersNode = new FunctionParamBuilder(typeRegistry).build();
256 |       }
257 |     } else {
258 |       // We're overriding with a function literal. Apply type information
259 |       // to each parameter of the literal.
260 |       FunctionParamBuilder paramBuilder =
261 |           new FunctionParamBuilder(typeRegistry);
262 |       Iterator<Node> oldParams = oldType.getParameters().iterator();
263 |       boolean warnedAboutArgList = false;
264 |       boolean oldParamsListHitOptArgs = false;
265 |       for (Node currentParam = paramsParent.getFirstChild();
266 |            currentParam != null; currentParam = currentParam.getNext()) {
267 |         if (oldParams.hasNext()) {
268 |           Node oldParam = oldParams.next();
269 |           Node newParam = paramBuilder.newParameterFromNode(oldParam);
270 | 
271 |           oldParamsListHitOptArgs = oldParamsListHitOptArgs ||
272 |               oldParam.isVarArgs() ||
273 |               oldParam.isOptionalArg();
274 | 
275 |           // The subclass method might write its var_args as individual
276 |           // arguments.
277 |           if (currentParam.getNext() != null && newParam.isVarArgs()) {
278 |             newParam.setVarArgs(false);
279 |             newParam.setOptionalArg(true);
280 |           }
281 |         } else {
282 |           warnedAboutArgList |= addParameter(
283 |               paramBuilder,
284 |               typeRegistry.getNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE),
285 |               warnedAboutArgList,
286 |               codingConvention.isOptionalParameter(currentParam) ||
287 |                   oldParamsListHitOptArgs,
288 |               codingConvention.isVarArgsParameter(currentParam));
289 |         }
290 |       }
291 | 
292 |       // Clone any remaining params that aren't in the function literal,
293 |       // but make them optional.
294 |       while (oldParams.hasNext()) {
295 |         paramBuilder.newOptionalParameterFromNode(oldParams.next());
296 |       }
297 | 
298 |       parametersNode = paramBuilder.build();
299 |     }
300 |     return this;
301 |   }

/**
     * Updates our representation of the global namespace to reflect a read
     * of a global name.
     *
     * @param t The traversal
     * @param n The node currently being visited
     * @param parent {@code n}'s parent
     * @param name The global name (e.g. "a" or "a.b.c.d")
     */
Method code:
628 |     void handleGet(NodeTraversal t, Node n, Node parent, String name) {
629 |       if (maybeHandlePrototypePrefix(t, n, parent, name)) return;
630 | 
631 |       Ref.Type type = Ref.Type.DIRECT_GET;
632 |       if (parent != null) {
633 |         switch (parent.getType()) {
634 |           case Token.IF:
635 |           case Token.TYPEOF:
636 |           case Token.VOID:
637 |           case Token.NOT:
638 |           case Token.BITNOT:
639 |           case Token.POS:
640 |           case Token.NEG:
641 |             break;
642 |           case Token.CALL:
643 |             type = n == parent.getFirstChild()
644 |                    ? Ref.Type.CALL_GET
645 |                    : Ref.Type.ALIASING_GET;
646 |             break;
647 |           case Token.NEW:
648 |             type = n == parent.getFirstChild()
649 |                    ? Ref.Type.DIRECT_GET
650 |                    : Ref.Type.ALIASING_GET;
651 |             break;
652 |           case Token.OR:
653 |           case Token.AND:
654 |             // This node is x or y in (x||y) or (x&&y). We only know that an
655 |             // alias is not getting created for this name if the result is used
656 |             // in a boolean context or assigned to the same name
657 |             // (e.g. var a = a || {}).
658 |             type = determineGetTypeForHookOrBooleanExpr(t, parent, name);
659 |             break;
660 |           case Token.HOOK:
661 |             if (n != parent.getFirstChild()) {
662 |               // This node is y or z in (x?y:z). We only know that an alias is
663 |               // not getting created for this name if the result is assigned to
664 |               // the same name (e.g. var a = a ? a : {}).
665 |               type = determineGetTypeForHookOrBooleanExpr(t, parent, name);
666 |             }
667 |             break;
668 |           case Token.DELPROP:
669 |             type = Ref.Type.DELETE_PROP;
670 |             break;
671 |           default:
672 |             type = Ref.Type.ALIASING_GET;
673 |             break;
674 |         }
675 |       }
676 | 
677 |       handleGet(t, n, parent, name, type);
678 |     }

664 |   private void compileInternal() {
665 |     setProgress(0.0);
666 |     parse();
667 |     // 15 percent of the work is assumed to be for parsing (based on some
668 |     // minimal analysis on big JS projects, of course this depends on options)
669 |     setProgress(0.15);
670 |     if (hasErrors()) {
671 |       return;
672 |     }
673 | 
674 |     if (!precheck()) {
675 |       return;
676 |     }
677 | 
678 |     if (options.nameAnonymousFunctionsOnly) {
679 |       // TODO(nicksantos): Move this into an instrument() phase maybe?
680 |       check();
681 |       return;
682 |     }
683 | 
684 |     if (!options.skipAllPasses) {
685 |       check();
686 |       if (hasErrors()) {
687 |         return;
688 |       }
689 | 
690 |       if (options.isExternExportsEnabled()
691 |           || options.externExportsPath != null) {
692 |         externExports();
693 |       }
694 | 
695 |       // IDE-mode is defined to stop here, before the heavy rewriting begins.
696 |       if (!options.ideMode) {
697 |         optimize();
698 |       }
699 |     }
700 | 
701 |     if (options.recordFunctionInformation) {
702 |       recordFunctionInformation();
703 |     }
704 | 
705 |     if (options.devMode == DevMode.START_AND_END) {
706 |       runSanityCheck();
707 |     }
708 |     setProgress(1.0);
709 |   }

/**
     * Declare the symbol for a qualified name in the global scope.
     *
     * @param info The doc info for this property.
     * @param n A top-level GETPROP node (it should not be contained inside
     *     another GETPROP).
     * @param parent The parent of {@code n}.
     * @param rhsValue The node that {@code n} is being initialized to,
     *     or {@code null} if this is a stub declaration.
     */
Method code:
1468 |     void maybeDeclareQualifiedName(NodeTraversal t, JSDocInfo info,
1469 |         Node n, Node parent, Node rhsValue) {
1470 |       Node ownerNode = n.getFirstChild();
1471 |       String ownerName = ownerNode.getQualifiedName();
1472 |       String qName = n.getQualifiedName();
1473 |       String propName = n.getLastChild().getString();
1474 |       Preconditions.checkArgument(qName != null && ownerName != null);
1475 | 
1476 |       // Precedence of type information on GETPROPs:
1477 |       // 1) @type annotation / @enum annotation
1478 |       // 2) ASSIGN to FUNCTION literal
1479 |       // 3) @param/@return annotation (with no function literal)
1480 |       // 4) ASSIGN to something marked @const
1481 |       // 5) ASSIGN to anything else
1482 |       //
1483 |       // 1, 3, and 4 are declarations, 5 is inferred, and 2 is a declaration iff
1484 |       // the function has JsDoc or has not been declared before.
1485 |       //
1486 |       // FUNCTION literals are special because TypedScopeCreator is very smart
1487 |       // about getting as much type information as possible for them.
1488 | 
1489 |       // Determining type for #1 + #2 + #3 + #4
1490 |       JSType valueType = getDeclaredType(t.getSourceName(), info, n, rhsValue);
1491 |       if (valueType == null && rhsValue != null) {
1492 |         // Determining type for #5
1493 |         valueType = rhsValue.getJSType();
1494 |       }
1495 | 
1496 |       // Function prototypes are special.
1497 |       // It's a common JS idiom to do:
1498 |       // F.prototype = { ... };
1499 |       // So if F does not have an explicitly declared super type,
1500 |       // allow F.prototype to be redefined arbitrarily.
1501 |       if ("prototype".equals(propName)) {
1502 |         Var qVar = scope.getVar(qName);
1503 |         if (qVar != null) {
1504 |           // If the programmer has declared that F inherits from Super,
1505 |           // and they assign F.prototype to an object literal,
1506 |           // then they are responsible for making sure that the object literal's
1507 |           // implicit prototype is set up appropriately. We just obey
1508 |           // the @extends tag.
1509 |           ObjectType qVarType = ObjectType.cast(qVar.getType());
1510 |           if (qVarType != null &&
1511 |               rhsValue != null &&
1512 |               rhsValue.isObjectLit()) {
1513 |             typeRegistry.resetImplicitPrototype(
1514 |                 rhsValue.getJSType(), qVarType.getImplicitPrototype());
1515 |           } else if (!qVar.isTypeInferred()) {
1516 |             // If the programmer has declared that F inherits from Super,
1517 |             // and they assign F.prototype to some arbitrary expression,
1518 |             // there's not much we can do. We just ignore the expression,
1519 |             // and hope they've annotated their code in a way to tell us
1520 |             // what props are going to be on that prototype.
1521 |             return;
1522 |           }
1523 |           if (qVar.getScope() == scope) {
1524 |             scope.undeclare(qVar);
1525 |           }
1526 |         }
1527 |       }
1528 | 
1529 |       if (valueType == null) {
1530 |         if (parent.isExprResult()) {
1531 |           stubDeclarations.add(new StubDeclaration(
1532 |               n,
1533 |               t.getInput() != null && t.getInput().isExtern(),
1534 |               ownerName));
1535 |         }
1536 | 
1537 |         return;
1538 |       }
1539 | 
1540 |       boolean inferred = isQualifiedNameInferred(
1541 |           qName, n, info, rhsValue, valueType);
1542 |       if (!inferred) {
1543 |         ObjectType ownerType = getObjectSlot(ownerName);
1544 |         if (ownerType != null) {
1545 |           // Only declare this as an official property if it has not been
1546 |           // declared yet.
1547 |           boolean isExtern = t.getInput() != null && t.getInput().isExtern();
1548 |           if ((!ownerType.hasOwnProperty(propName) ||
1549 |                ownerType.isPropertyTypeInferred(propName)) &&
1550 |               ((isExtern && !ownerType.isNativeObjectType()) ||
1551 |                !ownerType.isInstanceType())) {
1552 |             // If the property is undeclared or inferred, declare it now.
1553 |             ownerType.defineDeclaredProperty(propName, valueType, n);
1554 |           }
1555 |         }
1556 | 
1557 |         // If the property is already declared, the error will be
1558 |         // caught when we try to declare it in the current scope.
1559 |         defineSlot(n, parent, valueType, inferred);
1560 |       } else if (rhsValue != null && rhsValue.isTrue()) {
1561 |         // We declare these for delegate proxy method properties.
1562 |         FunctionType ownerType =
1563 |             JSType.toMaybeFunctionType(getObjectSlot(ownerName));
1564 |         if (ownerType != null) {
1565 |           JSType ownerTypeOfThis = ownerType.getTypeOfThis();
1566 |           String delegateName = codingConvention.getDelegateSuperclassName();
1567 |           JSType delegateType = delegateName == null ?
1568 |               null : typeRegistry.getType(delegateName);
1569 |           if (delegateType != null &&
1570 |               ownerTypeOfThis.isSubtype(delegateType)) {
1571 |             defineSlot(n, parent, getNativeType(BOOLEAN_TYPE), true);
1572 |           }
1573 |         }
1574 |       }
1575 |     }
